options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: desired_retention
options.description: The retention value for the Snapshot. If the retention value is not specified, the Snapshot details would be returned. To create a Snapshot, either a retention or expiration timestamp must be given. If the Snapshot does not have any retention value - specify it as 'None'.

options.name: expiration_timestamp
options.description: The expiration timestamp of the Snapshot. This should be provided in UTC format, e.g 2019-07-24T10:54:54Z.

options.name: is_secure
options.description: Indicates whether the snapshot is a secure snapshot. Secure snapshots cannot be deleted or have their retention reduced until the retention period expires. When set to C(true) during creation, I(expiration_timestamp) must be provided. Can also be set to C(true) on an existing snapshot to mark it as secure (one-way lock). This operation cannot be reverted.

options.name: new_snapshot_name
options.description: The new name of the Snapshot.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: retention_unit
options.description: The unit for retention. If this unit is not specified, C(hours) is taken as default I(retention_unit). If I(desired_retention) is specified, I(expiration_timestamp) cannot be specified.

options.name: snapshot_id
options.description: The ID of the Snapshot. Either snapshot ID or Snapshot name is required.

options.name: snapshot_name
options.description: The name of the Snapshot. Either snapshot name or ID is required.

options.name: state
options.description: Defines whether the Snapshot should exist or not.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: volume
options.description: The volume. This could be the volume name or ID.

options.name: volume_group
options.description: The volume group. This could be the volume group name or ID.
